11.title: Freeze a Course Snapshot: use List.copyOf
11.description: Implement `snapshot(List<Lesson> lessons)` with List.copyOf. The returned list should not allow add or remove operations, while the input list remains mutable and unchanged.
11.learningObjective: Create an unmodifiable list snapshot without changing the caller’s collection.
instructions: Return List.copyOf(lessons).
Do not wrap the original list with Collections.unmodifiableList.
Keep the input list unchanged.
Explain that the copy is shallow and rejects null elements.

workedExample.output: An unmodifiable list containing both lessons
workedExample.explanation: An unmodifiable snapshot prevents callers from changing list membership through the returned reference. Mutable elements remain shared, so this is a shallow copy.

11.hint: List.copyOf creates an unmodifiable copy of the collection structure; it does not deep-copy each Lesson object.
11.explanation: An unmodifiable snapshot prevents callers from changing list membership through the returned reference. Mutable elements remain shared, so this is a shallow copy.

testCases.description: Use List.copyOf.
Return both original elements in order.
Do not mutate the input list.
Do not claim the elements themselves are deeply immutable.

11.expectedOutput:

Freeze a Course Snapshot: use List.copyOf

Input: snapshot([HTML lesson, CSS lesson])

Expected value: An unmodifiable list containing both lessons

An unmodifiable snapshot prevents callers from changing list membership through the returned reference. Mutable elements remain shared, so this is a shallow copy.
